You expect a steady-state of long-tail interactive flows (avg request 350 tokens, median 120 tokens) with many short assistant queries mixed in. Hi Marissa — appreciate the notes and the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- Budget bands: leadership gave an initial range of $5k–$25k/month for the first 6 months; they want to see a path to <$12 / 1M tokens by month 3 if latency can be kept under 150ms p95 for the streaming assistant path.
- Volumes: baseline we'll provision for ~60M tokens/month, with predictable spikes up to 230M during campaigns. These spikes are concentrated (2–3hr windows) rather than sustained.

We like the proposed POC. Thanks — quick technical confirmation from my side to set expectations for the POC and the pricing bands: 

TL;DR: Continuous batching + prefix/KV caching will materially lower per-token cost for your workload shape, but the realized $/1M depends on average sequence lengths, cache hit rate, and chosen quantization. Estimates below assume Redwood Dedicated-hosted runtime with 8 GPU V100-equivalent slots for the POC.

Assumptions we used for the attached estimate:
- Baseline token mix: 60% short (<=128 tokens), 30% mid (129–512 tokens), 10% long (>512 tokens).
- Average request length for interactive assistant path: ~350 tokens.
- Cache hit rate (prefix/KV) for conversational re-asks: conservative 25%, optimistic 55%.
- Batching: continuous batching target batch size ~16 on average across requests; peak coalescing allows transient batches up to 48 when spikes align.
- Concurrency: avg 8 concurrent streams, peak 35 concurrent streams — we size autoscaling to keep p95 < 150ms for streaming endpoints.

Cost sensitivity (illustrative):
- With bfloat16 + conservative cache (25%): expect ~$18–$22 / 1M tokens at baseline volumes.
- With 8-bit quant + optimistic cache (55%): expect ~$9–$13 / 1M tokens.
- If you require strict p95 < 100ms and cannot accept extra batching delay, expect +15–25% on unit cost vs the numbers above because we trade batching depth for latency.

POC artifacts we can provide:
- 1k request trace with and without continuous batching enabled (raw timings, batch sizes, KV hits)
- Cost model spreadsheet (attached) parameterized by cache hit rate, avg tokens, quantization setting
- Small-kicker dashboard: per-route p50/p95/p99, batch-size distribution, token throughput by GPU slot

I'll prepare the trace harness and a short runbook for the platform team. Marissa — if Asha confirms the budget bands ($5k–$25k/month, target <$12 / 1M tokens by month 3), I'll schedule a short engineering sync next week to finalize POC infra and the sample dataset.

Cheers,
Priyom
